g.text: Something is wrong with the cluster

text.tspan: Does the index RQLite have a leader
and a reachable majority of voters?
Is the target still in the raft
Is the machine reachable over SSH
and meant to be erased now?
Is the namespace data wrong or lost
keep one node's data, reform around it
remove refuses: not a member or a non-voter.
Retire by hand (Known gaps), then wipe
wait for the tenant sweep (60 s)
stop the namespace rqlite unit, write
then run it; one node at a time
